rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for people working in an organization, including staff or military personnel.

example.english: The airport has assigned more personnel to maintain order.
example.traditional: 機場已經加派人員維持秩序。
example.jyutping: gei1 coeng4 ji5 ging1 gaa1 paai3 jan4 jyun4 wai4 ci4 dit6 zeoi6

rows.note: Use this for ordinary employees of a company or organization rather than military personnel or staff in general.

example.english: The company will give its personnel a bonus this year.
example.traditional: 公司今年會畀員工發花紅。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 wui5 bei2 jyun4 gung1 faat3 faa1 hung4

rows.note: Use this specifically for an organization's human resources department, as in a letter from personnel.

example.english: If you have any problems, just contact personnel.
example.traditional: 有問題就直接搵人事部啦。
example.jyutping: jau5 man6 tai4 zau6 zik6 zip3 wan2 jan4 si6 bou6 laa1
